title: Menagerie crawler operator requeue grant v2
description: One tool-minted operator requeue grant on the W31 schema rung: v2 = v1 + created_at + adjudication_key + effective_session_ceiling. The ladder is monotone -- v1 and pre-schema rows remain readable forever on their own terms -- and all three new fields ride OUTSIDE the grant_id preimage, exactly as schema_version always has, so no existing grant hash moved. adjudication_key is the recomputable identity of the adjudicated operator DECISION (member, stage, reason, and typed scopes; never attribution, allowance size, or row generation); effective_session_ceiling is the MC-Q4 keep-and-disclose figure stamped at issuance and never read back as authority.

grant_id.description: Canonical grant identity, the one preimage owned by menagerie.crawler.grant_identity.tool_grant_identity.

stable_id.description: Durable identifier of the granted model.

stage.description: Closed failure stage the grant re-authorizes, or the typed deferred-terminal sentinel for review-held null-stage deferrals (docket T2-05).

attempts.description: Author-attempt extension the granted work generation may spend beyond the base allowance (docket T1-13). Stays the enforced unit under MC-Q4.

granted_by.description: Operator identity that issued the grant.

new_work_generation.description: One-based ledger append generation allocated at issue time; folded into grant_id.

created_at.description: Timezone-aware UTC issuance timestamp; outside the grant identity by design, and the grant-aging census's age evidence.

adjudication_key.description: Recomputable identity of the adjudicated decision, owned by menagerie.crawler.grant_identity.requeue_adjudication_key. At most ONE live grant per key; readers recompute and refuse a mismatch, so the persisted field can never steer the decision identity.

effective_session_ceiling.description: MC-Q4 disclosure: the worst-case paid guard-session ceiling attempts:N implied at issuance (attempts x EFFECTIVE_SESSIONS_PER_GRANTED_ATTEMPT under that day's constants). Disclosure only; no consumer derives authority from it.

blocked_award_revision.description: Optional exact runs record revision this grant authorizes superseding (AW-1). Folded into grant_id only when present; the single authority that releases the award-custody tripwire.

target_intent.description: Optional dependency-evidenced environment correction for the new work generation.

capability.description: Optional typed capability this grant authorizes. Only a grant NAMING host-capability-routing may re-open a deferred:needs-more-memory head; a generic requeue never does, because a new work id is not evidence that the host gained memory.
